policies.title: Six ASEAN ordinary passports: airport-only 14-day tourist visa waiver
policies.summary: The official eVisa notice waives a tourist visa for these ordinary passports for 14 days when both entry and departure use the three named international airports.
conditions: Applies to tourist visits of up to 14 days only, effective under the notice from 1 September 2022.
Entry and departure must be through Yangon, Mandalay, or Nay Pyi Taw international airports; the notice does not extend this waiver to land or sea routes.
The current MFA bilateral schedule also records ordinary-passport exemptions for these nationalities.
It does not establish work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special-document, restricted-area, security, or individual-admissibility treatment.

policies.title: Malaysia ordinary passports: 14-day bilateral visa exemption
policies.summary: Myanmar MFA’s current bilateral-agreement schedule records a 14-day ordinary-passport exemption for Malaysia.
conditions: Maximum stay is 14 days as recorded in the MFA’s 27 January 2026 ordinary-passport schedule.
The bilateral schedule does not supply a route, purpose, work, residence, transit, special-document, restricted-area, security, or individual-admissibility determination.

policies.title: Vietnam ordinary passports: airport-only 30-day tourist visa waiver
policies.summary: The official eVisa notice waives a tourist visa for Vietnamese ordinary passports for 30 days when both entry and departure use the three named international airports.
conditions: Applies to tourist visits of up to 30 days only, effective under the notice from 1 September 2022.
Entry and departure must be through Yangon, Mandalay, or Nay Pyi Taw international airports; the notice does not extend this waiver to land or sea routes.
The current MFA bilateral schedule also records a 30-day ordinary-passport exemption.
It does not establish work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special-document, restricted-area, security, or individual-admissibility treatment.

policies.title: Russia ordinary passports: 30-day bilateral visa exemption
policies.summary: Myanmar MFA’s current bilateral-agreement schedule records a 30-day ordinary-passport exemption for Russia.
conditions: Maximum stay is 30 days as recorded in the MFA’s 27 January 2026 ordinary-passport schedule.
The bilateral schedule does not supply a route, purpose, work, residence, transit, special-document, restricted-area, security, or individual-admissibility determination.

policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: 30-day tourist waiver at international checkpoints
policies.summary: The official eVisa notice waives a tourist visa for Singapore ordinary passports for 30 days at all international checkpoints.
conditions: Applies to tourist visits of up to 30 days. Unlike the airport-only cohorts, the notice says all international checkpoints.
The current MFA bilateral schedule also records a 30-day ordinary-passport exemption.
It does not establish work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special-document, restricted-area, security, or individual-admissibility treatment.

policies.title: Twelve ordinary passports: direct airport Tourist Visa on Arrival
policies.summary: Myanmar MFA's current visitor guidance directly permits these ordinary-passport holders to apply for a 30-day Tourist Visa on Arrival at the named airport immigration sections; this is distinct from the separate preapproved eVisa route. Russia is excluded because its current visa-free waiver is the easier documented route.
conditions: The Ministry lists China, Italy, Australia, Germany, India, Spain, Switzerland and Russia, then adds Austria, Hungary, New Zealand, Czechia and Luxembourg for Tourist Visa on Arrival from 1 January 2020. Russia is not modelled here because its visa-free waiver is easier.
Apply at Yangon, Mandalay or Nay Pyi Taw International Airport Immigration Section. The published tourist stay is 30 days and the stated fee is USD 50.
Bring a passport valid for at least six months, two current photographs and meet the listed travel, accommodation, restricted-area and individual-admission conditions.

This direct airport route does not establish a visa-free exemption, electronic issuance, land or sea entry, work, residence, transit, diplomatic/official documents, or any individual right of admission.

application.label: Myanmar MFA direct Tourist Visa on Arrival guidance
steps: Use an eligible ordinary passport and prepare the stated passport-validity, photograph and visitor documents.
Arrive through Yangon, Mandalay or Nay Pyi Taw International Airport and apply at the Airport Immigration Section.
Pay the published tourist-visa fee and remain subject to the arrival scrutiny and issuing team's decision.

policies.title: Other listed ordinary passports: mandatory preapproved, arrival-issued Tourist visa
policies.summary: Myanmar’s live official Tourist Visa notice lists these ordinary-passport nationalities and territories. Apart from the separately documented direct Tourist Visa on Arrival cohort, applicants must obtain an online approval letter before travel; Immigration then issues and stamps the visa at arrival.
conditions: Tourist route only: obtain an approved eVisa Approval Letter before travel. The current FAQ says the visa itself is issued and stamped in the passport at the Myanmar Immigration Arrival counter, so the normalized status is visa_on_arrival.

The Terms and Conditions say an eVisa Approval Letter is not a confirmed visa. Print it and present it to the Immigration Officer on arrival; the FAQ says it is not a walk-up Visa on Arrival desk process.

Only an ordinary passport is accepted, with at least six months’ validity; a return ticket and booking at registered accommodation are required. Kawthaung land-border applicants may present a trip plan instead of a return ticket.

Entry is limited to Yangon, Mandalay, or Nay Pyi Taw international airports and Kawthaung International Land Border Checkpoint. The eVisa cannot be used for sea entry; cruises use a tour-agent pre-arranged visa-on-arrival route.
The approval letter is valid for 90 days from issue; the visa permits one tourist entry and up to 28 days after arrival. Processing takes at least three working days.

Travel to restricted areas requires separate confirmation. This policy does not establish business, work, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special-document, security, or individual-admissibility rights.

application.label: Myanmar eVisa official service: required approval before arrival issuance
application.processingTime: At least three working days according to the current Tourist Visa notice and FAQ.
steps: Use the Tourist eVisa application with the same eligible ordinary passport intended for travel.
Upload the required passport and photograph documents, provide itinerary and registered-accommodation evidence, and pay by accepted card.
Receive and print the mandatory Approval Letter before travel; it is not the issued visa.
Present the letter and passport at an eligible Myanmar entry point, where Immigration issues and stamps the visa.
